players.bio: Bruno Barticciotto Di Bartolo (born 7 May 2001) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a forward for Mexican club Santos Laguna on loan from Argentne club Talleres.

César Roman Ibáñez (born 17 June 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Huracán. Club career Ibáñez came through the youth ranks of Huracán, having joined at the age of eight.
Diego Hernán Martínez (born 16 November 1978) is an Argentine football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the current manager of Huracán.
Pedro Emmanuel Ojeda (born 5 November 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Huracán, on loan from Universidad de Chile.
Eric Ramírez (born 21st September 1996) is an Argentine footballer who plays as an Centre-Forward for Gimnasia LP.

Fabio Jesús Pereyra (born 31 January 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine team Huracán. Career Pereyra began in the ranks of Club Ateneo, before signing with CAI of Torneo Argentino A as the defender was selected in thirteen matches during the 2011–12 campaign which ended with relegation.

Facundo Federico Waller Martiarena (born 9 April 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Huracán, on loan from Liga MX club Puebla. Club career A youth academy graduate of Plaza Colonia, Waller made his professional debut on 19 April 2014 in a 1–1 draw against Rocha.

Federico Gabriel Vera (born 24 March 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Independiente. Career Vera left Banco Provincial to join Unión Santa Fe at the age of twelve, having been scouted at the Tiburón Lagunero tournament.

Guillermo Enio Burdisso (born 26 September 1988 in Altos de Chipion, Argentina) is an Argentine football defender who plays for Club Atlético Independiente. Guillermo is the younger brother of Torino defender Nicolás Burdisso. He has spent his entire career playing in Argentina, apart from a loan spell at his brother's club in the 2010-11 season.

Hernán Ismael Galíndez (born 30 March 1987) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Huracán. Born in Argentina, he represents the Ecuador national team. Born in Argentina, he began his career in Argentina with Rosario Central before settling in Ecuador with Universidad Católica, where he made over 300 appearances in a nine-year spell.
Ignacio Pussetto (born 21 December 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Argentine club Huracán.

Jordy Josué Caicedo Medina (born 18 November 1997) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine club Huracán, on loan from Mexican club Atlas, and the Ecuador national team. As a child, Caicedo played football "in rich boy" neighborhoods, bet money and always won.

Juan Francisco Bisanz (born 28 August 2001 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a winger and his current team is Huracán, from the Argentine First Division. Career Trained in Atlanta's youth teams, he made his debut in the first team in 2021 for the Primera B Nacional. He played a total of two seasons with the club.
Leandro Ariel Lescano (born 3 March 2003) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a defender for Huracán. Technical features He is a left-back.
Leonardo Roque Albano Gil Chiguay (born 31 May 1991) is an Argentine-Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Huracán.

Leonardo Exequiel Sequeira (born 26 April 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Uruguayan club Peñarol on loan from Chilean club Everton. Career Sequeira started his career in Santiago del Estero with Central Córdoba, after youth spells with Agua y Energía and Vélez de San Ramón.

Lucas Blondel (born 14 September 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors. Born in Argentina, he represents the Switzerland national team.

Luciano Giménez Alanda (born 18 February 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Huracán, on loan from Estudiantes. Career Born in Salta, Giménez joined Boca Juniors' youth setup in April 2016, from hometown side Central Norte. On 13 November 2020, after finishing his formation, he returned to his previous club on loan.

Nehuén Mario Paz (born 28 April 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Independiente Rivadavia as a centre-back. Paz's career began in 2013 with All Boys in the Argentine Primera División.

Óscar Manuel Cortés Cortés (born 3 December 2003) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership side Rangers, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lens. Cortés has represented Colombia at under-20 level.

Óscar David Romero Villamayor (born 4 July 1992) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Internacional and the Paraguay national team. He is the twin brother of Ángel Romero.
Rodrigo Fernández Cedrés (born 3 January 1996) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Argentine club Newell's Old Boys, on loan from Brazilian club Santos.

Sebastián Tomás Meza (born 14 March 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Huracán. Career Meza joined Huracán in 2018, having previously played for his hometown team Ex Alumnos Escuela N°185. He signed his first professional contract on 6 March 2020. His unofficial bow came in early October in a friendly against Talleres.
